name: site/container
title: Container
summary: The max-width content wrapper of the marketing sites: centres content at one of three widths with the standard responsive gutters, as a div, section, main or article.

props.name: size
props.description: The width: `.container-custom` (the wide grid column), `.container-narrow` (the editorial column) or `.container-prose` (the reading measure).

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes, after the width utility.

behaviour: Renders one `as` element with data-slot="container" whose class is the width utility, then `class`.
It adds nothing else: no role, no aria, no wrapper.

prose-main.description: The reading measure, as <main>, with an id and an extra class.

aria: None; `as` picks a landmark element (main) or a sectioning one where the page needs it.

theming.brandOverlay: Nothing: it sets width and gutters only.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The width utilities set the max width and step the horizontal padding up per breakpoint (px-6, sm:px-8, lg:px-10).
contract:
contract
  slot is "container"
  class is "container-custom"
  when prose-main class is "container-prose py-12"
  when narrow-article class is "container-narrow"
  when default shows p "Content"
end

checks.say: A div by default, holding the content.
The id is on the element.
